notes.title: Updates to Steam Workshop Implementation
notes.content:
An issue was found where navigating the steam workshop menus were not always functioning as intended.

Added a method for deleting items if you want to remove duplicates or old iterations of levels.

Updating existing items is still an issue I am looking into, so the delete method is a temporary stop gap until I can figure out why updating existing items always seems to fail.
